headline: Senate passes ALS and epilepsy research bills while CDC director confirmation looms Wednesday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: Senate passed S. 4472, reauthorizing critical ALS therapies research through fiscal year 2031, and S. 494, establishing a national epilepsy research coordination plan. The chamber also passed a resolution recognizing the Fulbright Program's 80th anniversary while continuing debate on the AGOA Extension Act and advancing various health and education measures.
